gaps: Choreography and pacing: there are 5 shots, the median is 4.5 s and the longest runs 12.5 s, all on slow drift. The ice cracking needs weight (snap, drift apart, settle) and the shots need to be cut much tighter to the data beats.

The arc peaks too early and too flat. The 2012 record lands near 43% of the runtime, the chart then re-explains it, and the Greenland reveal has no build into it. The structure needs one escalation into a real peak at 60–80%.

Sound design is thin. A sustained pad and a few noise hits are not produced work. It needs real ice foley (cracks, groans, water), dynamics that open and close with the ice extent, and hits locked to each year change and to the bars landing.
